epistemic_conclusion: Under rigorous nested 5-fold cross-validation, out-of-sample attainability of arbitrary random geometries collapses to R^2 < 0.00 across all tested probe spaces (q0 probes: R^2_test = -0.061, all candidate banks: R^2_test = -0.076, plausible candidate banks: R^2_test = -0.015). Over 90% of random targets produce negative test R^2. By contrast, substantive political targets achieve robust out-of-sample attainability (held-out r = 0.65 - 0.78), definitively refuting the hypothesis that arbitrary semantic geometry can be manufactured out-of-sample.
